title: Hold retention money in a trust account
what: Pay retention money held under a construction contract into a retention money trust account, established within 10 business days of the contract.

laws.title: Building and Construction Industry (Security of Payment) Act 2021 (WA)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry (Security of Payment) Act 2021 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A party to a construction contract who retains retention money under the contract that is held on trust under this Part must ensure that the money is paid into a trust account established by that party with a recognised financial institution in accordance with this Part (a retention money trust account)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry (Security of Payment) Act 2021 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The retention money trust account must be established within 10 business days after the parties enter into the construction contract
